scope: XSCore MinimalConfig SP1, ASAP7 RVT TT 0.7V 25C, standard-cell memories; ideal clock, pin capacitances only, zero interconnect

coverage.method: Exact same timing netlist and 1 ns constraints; check_setup list byte-identical; each listed endpoint resolved by STA find_pin and pin_sim_logic_value. Fixed configuration and reset=0 apply. Direct structural constants cross-checked. No automatic dynamic endpoint waiver.

interpretation: Measured pre-layout timing of this hierarchical standard-cell implementation. Not a technology-independent core Fmax, routed result, silicon measurement or same-RTL cross-library comparison.
